The Problem

Corporate training is fundamentally broken.

Companies spend billions on L&D programs that employees ignore, forget, or find irrelevant. Meanwhile, HR teams lack real visibility into workforce capabilities versus what the business actually needs to compete.

  • Generic content that doesn't match employee roles or goals
  • No real-time visibility into workforce skill gaps
  • High cost of managing disconnected training tools
  • Impossible to prove ROI on L&D investments
  • Low engagement with traditional LMS platforms

70% of L&D spend is wasted

on content employees never apply — McKinsey, 2024

How It Works

From guesswork to precision — in four steps.

Cademi turns your workforce data into a continuous learning engine that keeps your organization one step ahead.

01

Map your organization's skills

Cademi ingests your org chart, role definitions, and performance data to build a real-time skill map of every team and individual.

02

Identify the gaps that matter

Our AI cross-references your skill map with strategic business goals to surface the gaps that pose the greatest risk to growth.

03

Deploy personalized learning paths

Every employee receives a curated, adaptive curriculum drawn from the world's best content providers — built for their exact role.

04

Measure real business impact

Track completion, skill progression, and connect learning investments directly to productivity gains and business outcomes.

Our Story

Built by someone who lived the problem.

Marcus Reid

Founder & CEO, Cademi

Available for speaking

Founder & CEO

Marcus Reid

Former VP of Talent Strategy · McKinsey & Company · Harvard Business School

After a decade at McKinsey advising Fortune 500 companies on talent transformation, Marcus watched the same pattern repeat — billions allocated to training, almost nothing measurable to show for it. L&D was treated as a checkbox, not a competitive lever.

"I kept asking: why can't we treat workforce capability the same way we treat financial performance? With the same rigor, the same data, the same accountability. That question became Cademi."

In 2022, Marcus left consulting to build the platform he'd wished his clients had. Today, Cademi serves over 120 enterprise clients across three continents, and Marcus remains obsessive about one thing: making sure every training dollar moves the business forward.
